notes: Account overview: EU-headquartered fintech (KYC/AML workflows) evaluating Redwood Private VPC for customer-facing chat & internal compliance extraction.
Primary contact: Marco DeLuca (Head of Platforms) + Natalia Ruiz (CISO, final approver).
Security intake in motion: customer requested completed SIG/CAIQ and a vendor risk intake questionnaire. CISO asked for vendor-provided evidence for controls mapped to ISO27001 Annex A.

Main asks from security: BYOK support (customer-managed keys), HSM/EKM compatibility, separation of control plane, audit log forwarding to customer's SIEM, data residency guarantees (EU-only), retention and deletion proof points.

Architecture constraints: must sit inside customer's Azure VNet with VNet peering or PrivateLink equivalent; no public egress for inference traffic; allowed outbound endpoints only to Redwood control plane IPs for management channel.

Performance targets: p50 <= 80ms for 256-token chat flows, sustained throughput 120 qps for embeddings batch jobs during end-of-month processing; cost sensitivity moderate but reliability & compliance prioritized.
Model preferences: open-model family (Redwood-verified variants), prefer quantized/hardware-optimized builds; fallback routing policy required to a compatible smaller model if capacity constrained.

POC ask: 2-week private VPC trial inside customer subscription with BYOK KMS test key, audit log export to customer's SIEM, and sample dataset privacy review. SE to provide AMI/VM image and deployment runbook.
Quote from Natalia (CISO): "We need explicit shared responsibility for key lifecycle and proof that audit logs are immutable and exported off-platform."
Procurement notes: legal has a standard Data Processing Agreement but wants clarifications on subprocessor list and data residency clauses; finance requested preliminary ARR estimate for budgeting.

Risks noted: potential gap on retention_controls for derivative embeddings reuse; need explicit policy on model caching and KV prefix caching disabled for sensitive traffic or covered by encryption+zero retention.

Action items: (1) deliver SIG/CAIQ completed spreadsheet with attachments for evidence; (2) draft shared-responsibility matrix mapping Redwood vs Aperture responsibilities; (3) confirm BYOK workflow and HSM vendor compatibility (Azure Key Vault Managed HSM); (4) schedule demo of audit-log pipeline to SIEM.
Internal: AE/Jordan to coordinate legal + solutions; SE/Riley to produce runbook and SIG artifacts; CSM/Priya to prepare onboarding checklist if greenlit.
Linked artifacts: pricing deck + private deployment runbook in Drive (links above), earlier infra ticket INFRA-1123 opened to track VPC peering prerequisites.
Next meeting: security deep-dive w/ Natalia and infra team scheduled tentatively 2026-03-18 (pending availability).
